idea: Add a "row-mixing" closed form. Use r rows: rows of the first kind hold a squares of side 1/a (height 1/a), and rows of the second kind hold b squares of side 1/b. Their heights must satisfy x/a + y/b ≤ 1. Enumerate integers a, b, x, y with xa + yb ≥ n, keep the largest sides when trimming, and maximise x + y minus the trimmed sides. Also fill any leftover strip with a final row of c squares of side min(leftover height, 1/c).
